name: LinkFlow - Bulk URL Opener & Tab Manager
description: Open multiple URLs in bulk with custom delays, copy open tab links to clipboard, and organize active tabs with keyboard shortcuts.

copy-window-urls.description: Copy all current window URLs to clipboard

paste-window-urls.description: Open URLs from clipboard in new tabs

close-other-tabs.description: Close other tabs in the active window

close-left-tabs.description: Close tabs to the left of the active tab

close-right-tabs.description: Close tabs to the right of the active tab
